slides.texte_overlay:
1. Post less.
Live more.
Not every good moment
needs an audience.

2. Stop checking who
viewed your story.
It changes nothing
about your day.

3. Keep one project secret
for 30 days.
Build it without applause.
See how it feels.

4. Take a compliment
with a simple "thank you."
No deflecting.
No fishing for more.

5. Feed your own curiosity.
Learn things nobody
will ever ask you about.

5. Feed your own curiosity.
I swap my morning scroll
for 5 minutes on the Sophia app.
Just for me.
